literal: To those who do having thought having considered with a selected group, rare thing whatever even one is not.
translation: For those who deliberate thoroughly and act in the company of chosen associates, there is no achievement too difficult to attain.
modern: தக்க அறிஞர்கள் கூட்டத்தோடு சேர்ந்து, ஒரு செயலை நன்கு ஆராய்ந்து திட்டமிட்டுச் செய்பவர்களுக்கு, செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயல் என்று எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of careful planning and good counsel. The phrase 'terinta inattotu' refers to a well-chosen group of knowledgeable associates. When a person deliberates deeply with such a group before acting, no goal or achievement ('arumporul') remains out of reach.
